_readme: A case is scored only when verified=true AND must_contain holds a real phrase (not 'TODO').

To finish a draft case: open expected_file in documents/<service>/, find the passage that answers the query, copy a SHORT distinctive phrase from it into must_contain (matching ignores case and line breaks), correct expected_file if my guess is wrong, then set verified=true.
Write queries the way a normal citizen would ask, not copied from the PDF wording, so paraphrase handling is tested.
split='tune' cases are used while tuning; split='final' cases should be scored once at the end.
expected_file values marked verified=false are only my guesses from the file names.
